goal: Provide intent-based Feishu menus and dedicated task workspaces that run immediately after one explicit save action, deliver results without a second human-approval gate, and keep a truthful task center.

included: published menus: 创作, 办公, 任务

one shared H5 workspace for Feishu web, native clients, and company desktop entry across copy, image, video, research, file, preparation-team material quotation, AI-to-CDR batch conversion, and Codex intake
task-aware prompt, material, and server-whitelisted model/settings tabs
Codex Advanced Executor capability card and dedicated deep-reasoning intake
Card JSON 2.0 task intake, submitted-status, optional retained confirmation, and task-center cards
Harness audit timeline for automatically submitted Codex Advanced Executor calls
normal agent routing immediately after the user saves a valid task workspace
excluded: fabricated task counts or task records

network_access.shared_origin: http://192.168.1.35:6185 during LAN phase; HTTPS origin configured by DC_ASSISTANT_H5_ORIGIN after domain cutover
network_access.ingress: NAS LAN forward during phase 1; Tencent Cloud domestic reverse tunnel after domain cutover

acceptance_criteria.description: All published and legacy menu labels are handled before chitchat and provider routing.
Menu navigation, dedicated task forms, and task-center views do not invoke an LLM; saving a valid workspace is the single explicit execution boundary.
A valid workspace save enqueues one trusted internal start_task event and patches a non-blocking submitted-status card without presenting a second human confirmation step.
All registered builders produce Card JSON 2.0 payloads and image/video cards have distinct fields.
Codex toolbox navigation is deterministic, and only an explicitly confirmed user request resumes through the dedicated #codex工具 Advanced Executor marker.
The copy intake distinguishes Xiaohongshu notes, Douyin short-video scripts, and Xigua long-video scripts instead of collapsing every platform into generic social copy.

The attachment prototype exposes exactly one Card JSON 2.0 action that opens one compact H5 page with one shared intake panel, exactly two source actions for mixed-format local files and Feishu cloud documents, and one explicit confirmation action; cloud documents use standard Feishu OAuth and Drive OpenAPI when docsPicker is unavailable, and confirmation updates the original card with truthful metadata before closing the fixed right sidebar.

Copy, image, video, research, file, quotation, AI-to-CDR, and Codex task entry uses the direct capability URL only in Feishu web browsers, while native desktop and mobile clients use a sidebar-semi AppLink for the same H5; the H5 adapts from a compact sidebar wizard to a full-width browser desk, and a successful standalone save closes the workspace to reveal the originating assistant chat without opening another messenger page; every capability-token card keeps a deterministic refresh callback that replaces an expired URL in the originating card, API keys stay server-side, model selection defaults to Intelligent Choice, and saving a valid workspace automatically starts generation.

All Feishu sidebar H5 surfaces, including the task workspace, material quotation desk, attachment intake, media player chrome, and AI-to-CDR workspace, share the material-quotation visual system: white canvas, olive primary controls, signal-orange active states, Songti headings, compact rounded cards, and no gradients or tinted page decorations, while retaining existing task, upload, cloud-document, calculation, conversion, and playback behavior.

The two Office entries expose visibly distinct research and file-processing flows in both the entry card and right sidebar; file processing cannot be confirmed without an uploaded file, linked cloud document, or explicit file URL.
The Office menu includes a preparation-team material quotation entry backed by the dedicated feishu_material_quotation contract.

Every standard Feishu sidebar task workspace opens with Material first, then Task Prompt, then Output Settings; file-processing tasks validate an uploaded file, linked cloud document, or explicit file URL before validating the processing request.

Research content structures are separate from delivery channels, and every advertised Office delivery choice is backed by a real result card, Word, Excel, PDF, text file, or native Feishu cloud document instead of acting as prompt-only decoration.

The Office right-sidebar UI is one sequential three-step wizard—provide material, describe the goal, then choose delivery—with no competing workflow navigation; forward movement validates the current step, primary Office choices use touch-friendly cards, and the final step shows a live task overview before direct execution.
On the NAS runtime, uploaded file-processing materials persist directly under the mounted NAS inbox selected by DC_NAS_INBOX_DIR and never fall back to a Mac home path.

After a successful private-chat workbench result is delivered, one Card JSON 2.0 prompt closes the loop between opening a new AstrBot conversation and continuing the current conversation without becoming a second task approval gate.

The Office menu opens a NAS-hosted AI-to-CDR H5 workspace that accepts up to 20 AI files, keeps per-file CMYK mappings and a reserved ICC upload area, submits the batch atomically to the mounted NAS queue, and displays truthful per-file and aggregate percentages, elapsed time, estimated remaining time, errors, and completed CDR downloads while mini4 processes one desktop job at a time.

File processing exposes Translation only after material selection, requires a target language, keeps bidirectional translation optional, supports faithful or professional terminology-aware translation, offers target-only or bilingual output, and limits delivery choices to files the selected source type can really generate on a plain white three-step surface.

Translation bypasses the generic prompt-only file route and runs through the AstrBot AIHubMix provider with qwen-mt-turbo or qwen-mt-plus, preserves Word structure and Excel sheets, formulas, numbers, and basic styles, creates a real delivery artifact and trace manifest, and reports recoverable errors for unsupported, encrypted, scanned, oversized, partial, and language-direction failures.

Each assistant task chain owns one active interactive card: forward, back, refresh, task-detail, workspace-selection, and expired-capability recovery callbacks patch the originating Feishu message instead of appending another navigation card; workspace and submitted-result cards always retain that recovery callback, while a fresh menu entry may start a new card chain.

AIHubMix uses the domestic InferEra endpoint as its primary route and retries exactly once through the configured AWS proxy route only for connection failures, timeouts, or HTTP 408/502/503/504; authentication, permission, rate-limit, validation, and generic HTTP 500 errors remain visible and never trigger route fallback.

Every Feishu H5 change is released as one integrated chain covering the published menu label, its Card JSON 2.0 entry and recovery actions, the task-aware H5 route, and the NAS container origin for copy, image, video, research, file, quotation, AI-to-CDR, and Codex workspaces.

When a Feishu menu event is handled outside the NAS process, the capability and message binding are created on the configured NAS H5 origin before the card is usable; the sender never publishes a NAS URL backed only by an employee Mac draft store.

Creative submitted cards never regenerate from the card click itself: copy, image, and video reopen a freshly reloaded H5 revision view with the previous data filled, and only the explicit final H5 save starts another generation. Research, file-processing, and Codex submitted cards expose no regeneration action, while AI-to-CDR only reopens conversion progress.
